collection.credit:
🌴 Role Models and Good Examples — 40 New Isola Events

Forty original events for your Virtual Villagers anthology, numbered RM-01 through RM-40. Each has three or four choices, with two possible outcomes per choice. The events emphasize everyday integrity, compassion, fairness, responsibility, and respect without requiring perfect outcomes.

ledger.text: EVENT RM-08  -  THE UNFAMILIAR CUSTOM SETUP:
ledger.why: the event's number and title (the title) and the SETUP: marker; the source puts the whole event on one line

collection.description: A villager notices that a new neighbor observes a quiet personal custom before beginning the day's work.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A villager notices that a new neighbor observes a quiet personal custom before beginning the day's work.

choices.label: Ask politely whether the neighbor wishes to explain.
Discuss how different customs can fit into shared work.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The neighbor completes the custom peacefully, and the two begin working together.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The villager remains curious but decides that an explanation is not owed.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The neighbor shares a family tradition, and the villager listens with interest.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The neighbor prefers not to discuss it, and the villager accepts the answer.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The neighbor appreciates the consideration but says the current place is suitable.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The neighbor accepts, and the morning work begins a little later.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The neighbors arrange their tasks without requiring either to change personal beliefs.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: They discover a scheduling difficulty and agree to revisit it after trying an adjustment.
